candidates.summary: <details open> sycl: IQ3 code reorder (#29107) * sycl: persistent IQ3_S/IQ3_XXS weight reorder for SYCL decode and prefill Add persistent reordered weight layouts for IQ3_S and IQ3_XXS. Weights are reordered once at load time; the reordered MMVQ dot products then walk dense super-blocks with dp4a and SWAR sign expansion instead of gathering bits from the interleaved standard layout. Reorder-aware dequantization feeds the batched prefill GEMMs so prompt processing sees the same benefit. Also harden the oneDNN build check: a missing DNNL package or a CPU-only DNNL build now fails at configure

candidates.title: Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting for Language Agents
candidates.summary: Training language agents is bottlenecked by the high cost of long-horizon rollouts, yet standard agentic reinforcement learning (RL) learns only from a terminal scalar reward, leaving the supervision in intermediate steps largely unused. Prior work exploits this supervision through value targets that estimate per-step success probabilities or observation targets that fit environment response. candidates.title: One Task, Many Interfaces: Simple Cross-Interface Consistency Training Improves LLM Agent Robustness
candidates.summary: Post-training binds the competence of an LLM agent to the interface it was trained on. Semantics-preserving perturbations of that interface, such as renaming an action or changing the notation, leave the underlying task unchanged yet make the agent worse at it. candidates.summary: Brazilian Portuguese remains underserved by open-source language models, and the few that are safety-aligned rarely document what did not work or validate comparisons with statistical significance.
